freeze.development_result: The frozen v3 rule controller passed 5/5 rolling-v2 development windows; this result is exploratory and is not counted as v3 holdout evidence.

causal_prompt_amendment.reason: Make the full-handoff and masked-handoff Strategist instructions identical and provide a de-identified state-equivalent view, leaving only Analyst receipt content as the intended direct treatment.
causal_prompt_amendment.claim_scope: The matched Analyst comparison is transparent exploratory evidence, not a fully blinded confirmatory causal claim.

freeze.prior_static_visibility: The dates occur in the previously published all-window static benchmark; no rolling-v3 execution or Agent plan for these windows existed at freeze.

data.execution_trace: HP history from origin plus evaluation-window HP/Spot arrivals
data.workload_history_trace: separate four-hour HP/Spot history used only through cutoff filters

candidate_scenario_roles.recent-history-replay: stress evidence used only after the declared SLO hierarchy is tied

rolling_contract.state_handoff: one simulator session preserves queue, allocation, remaining work, ledgers and predictive feedback across cutoffs
rolling_contract.candidate_state: short, previous-short and four-hour workload views plus live queue/SLO progress and calibrated forecast risk

multi_agent_superiority_requires: no fewer hard-SLO-passing holdout windows than every deployable comparator
the same three-candidate and two-scenario simulator budget as workload-rule, single-agent and masked-handoff arms
a strictly better declared SLO hierarchy outcome than workload-rule, single-agent and masked-handoff arms
all Agent decisions bound to cutoff observation fingerprints before hidden future execution
analyst_causal_value_requires: full-handoff multi-agent is strictly better than matched-call masked-handoff multi-agent
the only intended difference is the Analyst content visible to the Strategist
claim_gate.otherwise: report that multi-agent scheduling superiority or Analyst causal value is not established
